{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperdrive coupling''' was a component used in [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]. The [[Microbinoculars|video microbinoculars]] of a [[WED Treadwell repair droid/Legends|WED Treadwell repair droid]] were capable of detecting hairline fractures in the coupling.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
